verdict.rationale: There is genuine third-party ecosystem evidence: a curated 'awesome-jev' list with 339 entries across 14 categories and 1,253 stars, third-party open-weight replicas on Hugging Face, and an independent drop-in SDK adapter package (system-one-adapter-python) plus a Claude Code/Codex agent-skill marketplace integration. However, none of this evidence speaks to maintainer activity/cadence, and the awesome-list itself disclaims curation ('a listing is not an endorsement'), so 'genuinely alive with active maintainers' is only partially substantiated. Missing for 10: evidence of ongoing maintenance/commit activity on third-party tools, presence of dedicated routers beyond first-party patterns, and independent community discussion confirming ecosystem vibrancy beyond a single curated list.
